name: Luneta Browser Bookmark
description: Search, navigate and open browser bookmarks.

preferences.name: Profiles
preferences.description: key=value records separated by semicolon (;). Example: personal=~/.config/google-chrome/Default/; work=~/.config/google-chrome/Profile 1/

preferences.name: Items limit
preferences.description: The extension will show up to this number of items in the list. Leave empty for no limit

preferences.name: Base Bookmark Path
preferences.description: Choose which base path to use

preferences.name: Update Date Last Used of Bookmarks
preferences.description: Update the date last used of bookmarks when they are opened so that recent bookmarks appear first in the results. However, this writes to the Chrome bookmarks file and can lead to issues
